An '''Iktotchi Sith Lord''' reigned as a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lord]] of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]. At some point during the [[Iktotchi/Legends|Iktotchi's]] lifetime, they searched for a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], and used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to aid them in [[Force Track|tracking]] the individual. The Sith Lord had [[Color/Legends|red]] and black [[Tattoo/Legends|tattoos]], and his right [[Eye/Legends|eye]] was yellow. Their face's left side was covered with a [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] enhancement. The Iktotchi was [[Force-sensitive/Legends|sensitive]] to the Force, and dressed in black [[Sith apparel|Sith robes]].<ref name="JATM" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Iktotchi Sith Lord appeared in an image created for the ''[[Jedi Academy Training Manual]]'', a resource guide for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''. The image was used to demonstrate a Force technique called "Force Track."<ref name="JATM" />
